pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.3: tā akkhamā honti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.4: uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭakānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ anadhivāsakajātikā honti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.5: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.7: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.10: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.11: ūnadvādasavassā hi bhikkhave gihigatā akkhamā hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.12: uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ anadhivāsakajātikā hoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.13: dvādasavassā ca kho bhikkhave gihigatā khamā hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.14: uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātikā hoti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:1.17.1: yā pana bhikkhunī ūnadvādasavassaṃ gihigataṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:2.1.11: vuṭṭhāpessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariniṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc65:2.1.15: gaṇassa ca ācariniyā ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
